background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group AA-, Moody's A1 and S&P A-, all stable, with no agency action since Moody's upgrade to A1 on 3 May 2023. Capital sits on the weak side of US banks: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter of the group and leverage of 5.5% is below the median. Liquidity is no better placed, with LCR of 112% below the median, and none of the three ratios has moved materially over the past four periods on figures to 30 Jun 2026. What is live is the news flow rather than the ratios: the newest flagged item, on 22 Sep 2026, warns that unrealised losses on the bond portfolio could widen as yields rise, and a share-price fall following management remarks at an industry conference has been flagged alongside it.
